body: Nearly 200 nations failed to agree a climate deal on Sunday — the first collapse of a UN climate summit since Copenhagen in 2009. The EU called the final text backsliding on science; the UK called it immensely disappointing.
hero.caption: Antalya, Türkiye — COP31 ran two days into overtime before its president closed the plenary without consensus.
hero.headline: COP31 ends with no deal
hero.standfirst: The longest climate summit on record ends with no deal in Antalya, after the EU and Britain walked out.
